Mijn lesmap is een spiegel: wat je in LA: My lesson folder is a mirror: what you delete in LANcelot disappears there too. The test archive only grows. Per school year, subject and month there is a folder per test with the test as it was taken, the answers and points (resultaten.csv opens in Excel) and a pdf per pupil. If you change a mark later, a new pdf is added and the old one goes to "eerdere versies". Handy for inspections, parent meetings and staff meetings.
